_note: Audience comments on the original public posts, harvested 12 Sep 2026. Arabic is the comment as written; 'en' is a translation. Only comments about the work or the people who made it are kept — grief and politics about the subject are deliberately excluded, as is anything from the El Fasher City thread.

quotes.ar: في كل مرة بتحضر الدروب بتكتشف انها اعمق و اجمل و اعظم من المرة القبلها. شكراً على العبقرية الفيها.
quotes.en: Every time you watch Al Doroub you find it deeper, more beautiful and greater than the time before. Thank you for the genius in it.

quotes.ar: مأساة شعب ومعاناته وماضيه وحاضره يأسه وأمله، ده كله في ٢٢ دقيقة. في إبداع أكتر من كده؟
quotes.en: A people's tragedy, their suffering, their past and their present, their despair and their hope — all of it in 22 minutes. Is there greater creativity than that?

quotes.ar: عمل إبداعي عظيم، نبش في ذاكرة الأرشيف، ربط وجداني ثقيل على العاطفة.
quotes.en: A great creative work. It dug into the memory of the archive — an emotional thread, heavy on the heart.

quotes.ar: إبداع وعظمة ورهبة ما حصلت في تاريخ الفن السوداني. شغل متقن ومعمول بي إحساس وحب وألم وأمل في الغد.
quotes.en: Creativity, greatness and awe that has not happened before in the history of Sudanese art. Work made with precision, made with feeling and love and pain and hope for tomorrow.

quotes.ar: عمل جميل جدا، قدرتوا تعكسوا الصورة كاملة. تستاهلوا جائزة عالمية عديل.
quotes.en: A very beautiful work — you managed to reflect the whole picture. You genuinely deserve an international award.

quotes.ar: من زمان بنحلم بي شغل محترم يوثق عظمة الثورة.
quotes.en: We have long dreamed of serious work that documents the greatness of the revolution.

quotes.ar: حقيقي عمل عظيم وإبداع ترجف له القلوب.
quotes.en: Truly a great work, and a creativity that makes hearts tremble.

quotes.ar: يعجز اللسان عن التعبير عن كمية الجمال والمجهود والعمل الجبار دا.
quotes.en: The tongue fails to express the amount of beauty, of effort, of titanic work in this.

quotes.ar: عمل كبير و متكامل و ملهم و شاحذ للهمم. نرفع القبعات لكل من شارك في هذا العمل العظيم.
quotes.en: A big, complete, inspiring work that sharpens resolve. Hats off to everyone who took part in it.

quotes.ar: عمل اكتر من عظيم، رمى حجر في بركة الاكتئاب واليأس وجدد جذوة المشاعر الوطنية الخالصة.
quotes.en: A work more than great. It threw a stone into the pond of depression and despair, and rekindled the ember of pure feeling for this country.

quotes.ar: بعلم الله، قشعريرة من روعة العمل العظيم ده.
quotes.en: God knows — goosebumps, from the beauty of this great work.
Magnificent. It told history through feeling.
Astonishing work. The summit of creativity.

quotes.ar: مجهود مقدر وعمل جميل وإبداع منقطع النظير.
quotes.en: Effort to be respected, a beautiful work, and a creativity without parallel.

quotes.ar: ده شغل عظيم يشبه الجيل ده بعظمتو.
quotes.en: This is great work — it resembles this generation in its greatness.
A great work that sets you drifting far away.

quotes.ar: يوقظ ليس فقط النيام بل حتى الأحلام.
quotes.en: It wakes not only the sleepers, but even the dreams.

quotes.ar: صحيح، يولد الإبداع من رحم المعاناة.
quotes.en: True — creativity is born from the womb of suffering.

quotes.ar: فخورين بيكم شديد، شكرا على مجهودكم.
quotes.en: We are so proud of you. Thank you for your effort.

quotes.ar: عمل مفروض كل الشعب السوداني يشوفوا.
quotes.en: A work every Sudanese person should see.
Here they were, and their spirits are still fluttering in the place.

about._what: Comments addressed to Ahmed or to the craft, from his own posts and posts about him — Facebook, X, all 34 Instagram posts, and TikTok (@by_nimeri, read from his own screenshots because TikTok will not render its grid to an automated session). Rendered on /about by bin-build-about-said.py. The El Fasher City thread is excluded at his instruction: war grief and politics, not reception of work. Note: the TikTok set responds to his AI-assisted Sudan series, which those posts label as AI-generated.

quotes.ar: الشاب المعاي في الصورة دا بمثل جزء كبير ومهم جدا في نجاح «العيد شوفة». احمد النميري، او «نمرة واحد» زي ما بحب اناديهو. شاب مبدع بمعنى الكلمة. هو اللي صور وقام بمونتاج الاغنية. عشان كدة لازم تتعرفوا عليهو.
quotes.en: The young man with me in this picture is a large and very important part of why “Al Eid Shofa” worked. Ahmed El-Nimeri — or “Number One”, as I like to call him. A creative young man in the full sense of the word. He shot the song and he cut it. Which is why you need to know who he is.

quotes.ar: نميري ياخ أستاذ فنان ما شاء الله
quotes.en: Nimeri, you are a master. An artist.

quotes.ar: ما شاء الله شغل جميل ومتقن

quotes.en: Honestly, terrific work. On to the world stage.
The pictures are full of life. I thank your art.
Absolutely well done cinematics there — love it
Wewe ni hadithi hai — you are a living legend

quotes.ar: شغل عملاق يا أحمد، ربنا يوفقك
quotes.en: Titanic work, Ahmed. May you go far.

quotes.ar: راجل بشوش ومرح وذكي، ربنا يوفقو دائماً ونشوف إبداعاتو مالية الساحة
quotes.en: A warm, funny, clever man. May he always succeed, and may we see his work fill the field.
Ahmed El-Nimeri is an artist, and a lovely man.

quotes.ar: أحمد زول موهوب، وإن شاء الله تعبو ما بروح ساكت
quotes.en: Ahmed is a talented man, and his effort will not go to waste.

quotes.ar: انا شفت فيديوهات كتيرة من القيادة لكن الدرجة دي من الاحترافية makes me speechless
quotes.en: I have seen a lot of videos from the sit-in, but this level of professionalism makes me speechless.
Just magical — a cinematic touch in every shot

quotes.ar: والله ما بنفهم في التصوير، لكن الإضاءة بتاعت الشمس والجو العام للصورة والإيقاع في المبنى والعواميد على الترتوار وزاوية الكاميرا، حقيقي جميلة
quotes.en: I honestly know nothing about photography. But the sunlight, the mood of the frame, the rhythm of the building and the columns along the pavement, and the angle of the camera — genuinely beautiful.

quotes.ar: التصوير ولا غلطة، ما شاء الله
جميلة لدرجة لا توصف. إبداع. أنا حسيت بنور السعادة. استمر
quotes.en: Beautiful beyond description. Creativity. I felt a light of happiness. Keep going.

quotes.ar: الله عليك يا نميري يا جميل
كمية من المشاعر ما عادية، يا فنان
quotes.en: An amount of feeling that is not normal. Artist.

quotes.ar: التصوير فنان عديل، ما شاء الله
ما شاء الله تبارك الله، شغل بعيد

quotes.en: An artist. The most artist thing there is.
MashAllah Ahmed, so proud of you
Sudan is red and gold — beautiful shots
The images are full of life. I thank your art.

quotes.ar: فن اختيار الأغاني، ما شاء الله
quotes.en: The art of choosing the music.

quotes.ar: حاسه إني شايفاها بقلبي ما عيوني
quotes.en: I feel like I am seeing it with my heart, not my eyes.

quotes.ar: اخيرا زول بصور اللحظة زي ما بشوفها أنا
quotes.en: Finally, someone who photographs the moment the way I see it.
First time to see it this way. Wow — creativity.

quotes.ar: الصور ف بعد تاني، التفاصيل الما يشوفوها الناس
quotes.en: The pictures are on another level. The details people do not see.
Creativity, brother, in the full meaning of the word.
An artist. Very much an artist.
